comment: I2L: the Lab's deployment inputs, NAMES only (values live in the operator's stores, never here). Origins are P-08 placeholders (TO BE VERIFIED). Read by apps/infrx-api/tests/i/lab and infra/lab/app/README.md.

lab-web.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_LAB_URL
lab-web.purpose: the Lab's own https origin, no path (apps/lab/lib/auth/config.ts)

lab-web.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
lab-web.purpose: the auth/DB project the Lab session door (0030) is served from

lab-web.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
lab-web.purpose: publishable key; the Lab holds no service-role key

lab-web.name: LAB_DATASETS_API_URL
lab-web.purpose: server-only base URL of the datasets backend (WR-N4-5); unset = the datasets pages are unavailable

lab-web.name: LAB_TRACES_API_URL
lab-web.purpose: server-only lab-api base URL for the provider trace read (V1M/WR-LAB-API-5); unset = the request pages read nothing and say so

lab-web.name: LAB_EVALS_API_URL
lab-web.purpose: server-only lab-api base URL for /lab/v1/evaluations (WR-B4-1, behind LAB_EVALS); unset = the evaluation pages are unavailable

lab-web.name: LAB_PIPELINES_API_URL
lab-web.purpose: server-only lab-api base URL for /lab/v1/pipelines (WR-P4-1, behind LAB_PIPELINES); unset = the annotation and training pages are unavailable

lab-web.name: LAB_RELEASES_API_URL
lab-web.purpose: server-only lab-api base URL for /lab/v1/releases and /lab/v1/optimizations (WR-R4-1, behind LAB_RELEASES); unset = the release and optimization pages are unavailable

lab-web.name: LAB_CONTROL_URL
lab-web.purpose: server-only base URL of the Lab control service (R186's factory, the control origin above) for /lab/v1/control (WR-E3L-J); unset = the overview, models and deployments pages are unavailable

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_IMAGE
lab-control.purpose: the Lab control release: a content-addressed image id, rolled back by itself

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_DATABASE_URL
lab-control.purpose: the control service's own database login (L3-SQL names the role); never the runtime's DATABASE_URL

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_SUPABASE_URL
lab-control.purpose: where the control service verifies a Lab session token

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
lab-control.purpose: the publishable anon key the control service presents as apikey when verifying a Lab session token (GoTrueSessions); never the service-role key

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_ORIGIN
lab-control.purpose: the one browser origin whose Lab sessions it accepts

lab-workers.name: INFRX_IMAGE
lab-workers.purpose: the role's release in its own env file: a local content-addressed image id (sha256:<64 hex>, --pull never); never the App's INFRX_IMAGE

lab-workers.name: LAB_DATABASE_URL
lab-workers.purpose: the worker role's own Lab database login; never the runtime's DATABASE_URL

lab-workers.name: LAB_S3_BUCKET
lab-workers.purpose: the Lab object store bucket (instance-role credentials only; AWS_* refused)

lab-workers.name: LAB_S3_ENDPOINT
lab-workers.purpose: the Lab object store endpoint; its host may be in LAB_EGRESS_ALLOW

lab-workers.name: LAB_EGRESS_ALLOW
lab-workers.purpose: NO_PROXY allowlist: exactly the object store host, 169.254.169.254 and the enabled adapter's approved host

lab-workers.name: LAB_ANNOTATION_TEACHER
lab-workers.purpose: the annotation teacher adapter; default dry-run, any other needs its P-10 approval in egress.json

lab-workers.name: LAB_TEACHER_URL
lab-workers.purpose: the annotation role's teacher endpoint for collecting approved teacher batches (WR-P4B-2); the local teacher fake (http://127.0.0.1:<port>) only until P-10, its host in LAB_EGRESS_ALLOW; unset = the annotation role exits 2

lab-workers.name: LAB_ANNOTATION_TEACHER_URL
lab-workers.purpose: the approved teacher's https endpoint (non-default adapter only)

lab-workers.name: LAB_ANNOTATION_TEACHER_TOKEN
lab-workers.purpose: the teacher's purpose-specific token (non-default adapter only)

lab-workers.name: LAB_ANNOTATION_BUDGET_USD
lab-workers.purpose: the annotation USD budget, above 0 and within the P-10 approval's cap

lab-workers.name: LAB_ANNOTATION_PAYER_REF
lab-workers.purpose: exactly the P-10 approval's named payer

lab-workers.name: LAB_TRAINING_CONNECTOR
lab-workers.purpose: the training connector adapter; default manual-bundle, any other needs its P-11 approval in egress.json

lab-workers.name: LAB_TRAINING_CONNECTOR_URL
lab-workers.purpose: the approved connector's https endpoint (non-default adapter only)

lab-workers.name: LAB_TRAINING_CONNECTOR_TOKEN
lab-workers.purpose: the connector's purpose-specific token (non-default adapter only)

lab-workers.name: LAB_TRAINING_BUDGET_USD
lab-workers.purpose: the training USD budget, above 0 and within the P-11 approval's cap

lab-workers.name: LAB_TRAINING_PAYER_REF
lab-workers.purpose: exactly the P-11 approval's named payer

lab-edge.name: INFRX_LAB_CONTROL_SITE
lab-edge.purpose: the control origin's address in the App edge (default the placeholder above)

lab-edge.name: INFRX_LAB_CONTROL_UPSTREAM
lab-edge.purpose: local drill only; the box leaves it unset (127.0.0.1:8003)
